# paperclip_agent (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Paperclip agent by `id`, or by `name` within a company.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look an agent up by name within a company ...
data "paperclip_agent" "producer" {
  company_id = data.paperclip_company.studio.id
  name       = "Producer"
}

# ... or by identifier.
data "paperclip_agent" "by_id" {
  id = "8b1f6a0c-2d3e-4f5a-9b6c-7d8e9f0a1b2c"
}

# Attach a new agent to an existing manager.
resource "paperclip_agent" "assistant" {
  company_id   = data.paperclip_company.studio.id
  name         = "Production Assistant"
  reports_to   = data.paperclip_agent.producer.id
  adapter_type = "process"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `company_id` (String) Identifier of the company the agent works for. Required when looking the agent up by `name`.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the agent. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the agent. Requires `company_id`.

### Read-Only

- `adapter_type` (String) Adapter that runs the agent.
- `budget_monthly_cents` (Number) Monthly spending limit for the agent, in cents. `0` means no limit.
- `capabilities` (String) Free-form description of what the agent is good at.
- `reports_to` (String) Identifier of the agent this agent reports to.
- `role` (String) Role of the agent in the organisation.
- `spent_monthly_cents` (Number) Amount the agent spent in the current month, in cents.
- `status` (String) Current status of the agent, such as `idle`, `running`, `paused` or `error`.
- `title` (String) Job title shown in the organisation chart.
- `url_key` (String) URL-safe key of the agent, derived from its name.
